methods.name: DismissDialog
methods.description: Dismisses the custom list picker dialog.

methods.name: ShowListPicker
methods.description: Shows the custom list picker dialog.

methods.name: ShowMultiChoicePicker
methods.description: Shows a multiple choice list picker dialog.

methods.name: ShowSingleChoicePicker
methods.description: Shows a single choice list picker dialog

blockProperties.name: BackgroundColor
blockProperties.description: Sets the background color of the custom list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: Cancellable
blockProperties.description: Sets whether the dialog is cancellable or not

blockProperties.name: DialogHeight
blockProperties.description: Sets the height of the dialog in pixels. Set 0 for automatic.

blockProperties.name: DividerColor
blockProperties.description: Sets the color of the divider line between list items.

blockProperties.name: Elements
blockProperties.description: Sets the list items for the custom list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: ElementsFromString
blockProperties.description: Sets the list items for the custom list picker dialog from a comma-separated string value.

blockProperties.name: FontBold
blockProperties.description: Sets the bold style for the dialog font.

blockProperties.name: FontSize
blockProperties.description: Sets the font size of the list items in the custom list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: FontTypeface
blockProperties.description: Sets the typeface for the custom list picker dialog text.

blockProperties.name: FontTypefaceBold
blockProperties.description: Property for FontTypefaceBold

blockProperties.name: HintTextColor
blockProperties.description: Sets the hint text color of the filter bar.

blockProperties.name: ItemHeight
blockProperties.description: Sets the height of the list items in the custom list picker dialog. Use 0 for automatic height.

blockProperties.name: NegativeButtonText
blockProperties.description: Sets the negative button text for dialog.

blockProperties.name: PositiveButtonText
blockProperties.description: Sets the positive button text for dialog.

blockProperties.name: RememberChoices
blockProperties.description: When set to true, the extension remembers the previous selected choices and checks them when selecting items again. When set to false, all items will be unchecked every time the dialog is shown.

blockProperties.name: SearchHintText
blockProperties.description: Sets the hint text for the search box in the custom list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: SelectedIndex
blockProperties.description: Sets the index of the item to be pre-selected in the single choice list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: Selection
blockProperties.description: Returns the selected item from the custom list picker.

blockProperties.name: SelectionIndex
blockProperties.description: Returns the index of the selected item from the custom list picker. Index starts from 1.

blockProperties.name: SelectionIndices
blockProperties.description: Returns the indices of the selected items from multi list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: Selections
blockProperties.description: Returns the selected items from multi list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: ShowFilterBar
blockProperties.description: Sets the visibility of the filter bar in the custom list picker dialog.

blockProperties.name: TextColor
blockProperties.description: Sets the text color of the custom list picker dialog text.

blockProperties.name: Title
blockProperties.description: Sets the title of the custom list picker dialog.

name: CustomListPicker
helpString: Custom List Picker extnesion to show different types of list picker dialog. Developed by The K Studio.

events.name: AfterMultiPicking
events.description: Event triggered after picking multiple items from mutli picker dialog.

events.name: AfterPicking
events.description: Event indicating that the user has picked an item from the custom list picker.

events.name: AfterSinglePicking
events.description: Event triggered after picking a single item

events.name: MultiPickerCancelled
events.description: Event triggered when the multi-picker is cancelled or dismissed without selecting items

events.name: SinglePickerCancelled
events.description: Event triggered when the single-picker is cancelled or dismissed without selecting an item
